nodes.name: Daily 02:45 UTC
nodes.notes: Runs last of the four. This workflow sets triggerScoring, so the cohort is scored once on complete data rather than four times on partial data.

nodes.name: HPC plans (requirements)
nodes.notes: Verified shape: revisedRequirements is TOP-LEVEL on the plan, and this endpoint carries no funding figure at all — funding needs the separate flow call downstream.

nodes.name: Funding per plan
nodes.notes: One call per plan (~46/year). onError=continue so a single failing plan degrades that country's funding signal rather than aborting the run — the API treats a null funding gap as 'unknown', not 'fully funded'.

nodes.name: POST to Lumen API (scores)
nodes.notes: Longer timeout than the other three: this call also recomputes the whole cohort's scores before responding.
